domains.gamma_velocity: x^2<=1/17 and each external/internal q>=68 is sufficient; K=q*J/(q*Lambda^2-J)
domains.momentum: total sum zero; every nonempty proper subset sum nonzero; homogeneous/backreaction modes excluded
domains.phase: x in [-1,1], limiting endpoints included; no inverse Theta or Lambda
domains.time_derivative: fixed local ell; D_w=(1-x^2)d_x-2*x*q*d_q-2*w*x, w=0 unitary, w=1 gamma
domains.unitary_velocity: x^2>=1/65 is the covering exterior; K=J/Theta^2

ordering.Legendre_correction: three unordered 2+2 partitions; includes scalar and both tensor channels
ordering.labelled_leg_convention: coefficient of product epsilon_i; no 1/n! inserted

scope: D-only M0, cubic/quartic labelled Fourier kernels, arbitrary nonexceptional rational spatial momenta and rational TT polarizations
